name: The Will O Wisp Forest
source:
Elaine takes the first job she can find at a mansion on the forest’s edge. Night falls, and she follows Willo’s wisps, stumbling into a bog along the way. She keeps going and finally reaches a clearing with two familiar figures. 

What awaits her there?

[From [url=https://oohanaoo.itch.io/the-will-o-wisp-forest]Itch.io[/url]]
